AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC4626ExceededMaxDeposit(address,uint25.details: Attempted to deposit more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxMint(address,uint256,u.details: Attempted to mint more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(address,uint256.details: Attempted to redeem more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(address,uint2.details: Attempted to withdraw more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC7540ExceededDepositRequest(address,ui.details: Attempted to deposit more assets than the pending deposit request for `receiver`.

ERC7540ExceededRedeemRequest(address,uin.details: Attempted to redeem more assets than the pending redeem request for `receiver`.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

DepositRequest(address,address,uint256,a.details: `owner` has locked `assets` in the Vault to Request a deposit with request ID `requestId`. `controller` controls this Request. `sender` is the caller of the `requestDeposit` which may not be equal to the `owner`. - MUST be emitted when a deposit Request is submitted using the requestDeposit method.

OperatorSet(address,address,bool).details: The `controller` has set the `approved` status to an `operator`. - MUST be logged when the operator status is set. - MAY be logged when the operator status is set to the same status it was before the current call.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

RedeemRequest(address,address,uint256,ad.details: `sender` has locked `shares`, owned by `owner`, in the Vault to Request a redemption. `controller` controls this Request, but is not necessarily the `owner`. - MUST be emitted when a redemption Request is submitted using the `requestRedeem` method.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params.user: - Address to get the underlying balance of.

returns._0: - User's vault balance in underlying tokens.

batchProcessDepositRequest(address[],uin.details: - Only callable by the `manager` or `operator` of the Credit Strategy contract.

params.assets: - The amounts of the deposit requests to move from PENDING to CLAIMABLE.
params.controllers: - Addresses of the owners of the assets.
params.maxShares: - The maximum amounts of shares that can be minted.
params.minShares: - The minimum amounts of shares that can be minted.

returns._0: - True if the deposit request was successfully processed.

batchProcessRedeemRequest(address[],uint.details: - Only callable by the `manager` or `operator` of the Credit Strategy contract.- The vault manager or operator must ensure that the vault has sufficient liquidity to process the redemption requests.

params.controllers: - A list of addresses of the owners of the shares.
params.maxAssets: - A list of maximum amounts of assets that can be withdrawn.
params.minAssets: - A list of minimum amounts of assets that can be withdrawn.
params.shares: - A list of amounts of the redeem request to move from PENDING to CLAIMABLE.

returns._0: - True if the redeem request was successfully processed.

cancelDepositRequest(uint256,address,add.details: - Only callable by `controller` or its operators.

params.assets: - Amount of the deposit request to cancel.
params.controller: - Address of the owner of the Deposit Request.
params.receiver: - Address to receive assets from cancellation of Deposit Request.

returns._0: - True if the deposit request was successfully cancelled.

cancelRedeemRequest(uint256,address,addr.details: - Only callable by `controller` or its operators.

params.controller: - Address of the owner of the shares.
params.receiver: - Address of the owner of the shares.
params.shares: - Amount of the redeem request to cancel.

returns._0: - True if the redeem request was successfully cancelled.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

deposit(uint256,address).details: - If whitelist is enabled, only whitelisted addresses can deposit.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can deposit.

params.assets: - Amount of the underlying token to deposit.

returns.shares: - Amount of shares to transfer to receiver.

deposit(uint256,address,address).details: - If whitelist is enabled, only whitelisted addresses can deposit.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can deposit.

params.assets: - Amount of the underlying token to deposit.
params.controller: - Owner of the deposit Request, who can manage any actions related to the Request, including claiming the shares.

returns.shares: - Amount of shares to transfer to receiver.

depositIntoStrategy(uint256,uint256).details: - Only callable by the `manager` of the Credit Strategy contract.- Only callable if LendingVault has sufficient liquid assets.

params.strategyType: - Type of strategy to deposit into. 0 for Liquid Strategy, 1 for Credit Strategy

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.receiver: - Address to check the maximum deposit amount for.

returns._0: - Returns the maximum amount of underlying tokens a user can deposit into the vault.

params.receiver: - Address to check the maximum mint amount for.

returns._0: - Returns the maximum amount of vault shares the receiver can mint with underlying tokens.

params.owner: - Address to check the maximum redeem amount for.

returns._0: - Returns the maximum amount of shares the owner can redeem from the vault.

params.owner: - Address to check the maximum withdraw amount for.

returns._0: - Returns the maximum amount of assets the owner can withdraw from the vault.

migrateLiquidStrategy(address).details: - Only callable by the `manager` of the Credit Strategy contract.- Cannot migrate to a zero address.- Cannot migrate to a strategy that does not hold the same underlying asset as the LendingVault.

params._newLiquidStrategy: - Address of the new strategy contract

mint(uint256,address).details: - If whitelist is enabled, only whitelisted addresses can deposit.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can deposit.

params.receiver: - Address to receive newly minted shares.
params.shares: - Amount of the shares to mint.

returns.assets: - Amount of underlying tokens deposited to mint shares.

mint(uint256,address,address).details: - If whitelist is enabled, only whitelisted addresses can deposit.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can deposit.

params.controller: - Owner of the deposit Request, who can manage any actions related to the Request, including claiming the assets.
params.receiver: - Address to receive newly minted shares.
params.shares: - Amount of the shares to mint.

returns.assets: - Amount of underlying tokens deposited to mint shares.

mintFeeShares(address,uint256).details: - Only callable by the Credit Strategy contract.

params.receiver: - Address to receive the minted shares

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

processDepositRequest(address,uint256,ui.details: - Only callable by the `manager` or `operator` of the Credit Strategy contract.

params.assets: - Amount of the deposit request to move from PENDING to CLAIMABLE.
params.controller: - Address of the owner of the assets.
params.maxShares: - The maximum amount of shares that can be minted.
params.minShares: - The minimum amount of shares that can be minted.

returns._0: - True if the deposit request was successfully processed.

processRedeemRequest(address,uint256,uin.details: - Only callable by the `manager` or `operator` of the Credit Strategy contract.

params.controller: - Address of the owner of the shares.
params.maxAssets: - The maximum amount of assets that can be withdrawn.
params.minAssets: - The minimum amount of assets that can be withdrawn.
params.shares: - The amount of the redeem request to move from PENDING to CLAIMABLE.

returns._0: - True if the redeem request was successfully processed.

recoverTokens(address,address,uint256).details: - Only callable by the `manager` of the Credit Strategy contract.

params.to: - Address to send the recovered tokens to.
params.token: - Address of the ERC20 token to recover.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: - Reverts if msg.sender does not have sufficient allowance from owner.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can redeem.

params.controller: - Address where shares are burned to withdraw underlying tokens.
params.receiver: - Address to receive underlying tokens after burning shares.
params.shares: - Amount of shares to redeem for underlying tokens.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

requestDeposit(uint256,address,address).details: - If whitelist is enabled, only whitelisted addresses can deposit.- Cannot request to deposit 0 `assets`.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can request to deposit.

params.assets: - Amount of the underlying token to deposit.
params.controller: - Address to receive newly minted shares.
params.owner: - Address of the owner of the assets.

requestRedeem(uint256,address,address).details: - Cannot request to redeem 0 `shares`.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can request to deposit.

params.controller: - Address to receive the underlying tokens.
params.owner: - Address of the owner of the shares.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setCreditStrategy(address,address[]).details: - Can only be called once by `deployerFactory`.

params.approved: - True to add operator, false to remove operator.
params.operator: - Address of the operator to add or remove.

returns._0: - True if the operator was successfully added or removed.
- The value of a single vault share expressed in terms of underlying tokens.

params.interfaceId: - interface ID to check for support.

returns._0: - True if the contract supports the ERC-7540 interface.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

returns._0: - Total amount of underlying tokens the vault holds, has deployed to credit lines, and interest owed or repaid on those credit lines.
- The total amount of underlying tokens the vault holds.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: - Will revert if msg.sender does not have sufficient allowance from owner.- Only the `owner` or an `operator` can withdraw.

params.assets: - Amount of underlying tokens to withdraw by burning shares.
params.controller: - Address where underlying tokens are withdrawn from.
params.receiver: - Address to receive underlying tokens after burning shares.

returns.shares: - Amount of shares burned to withdraw underlying tokens.

withdrawFromStrategy(uint256,uint256).details: - Only callable by the `manager` of the Credit Strategy contract.

params.amount: - Amount of assets to withdraw from the Credit or Liquid Strategy contract
params.strategyType: - Type of strategy to withdraw from. 0 for Liquid Strategy, 1 for Credit Strategy

claimableDepositRequest.details: The amount of requested `assets` in Claimable state for the `controller` with the given `requestId` to `deposit` or `mint`. - MUST NOT include any `assets` in Pending state for `deposit` or `mint`. - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller. - MUST NOT revert unless due to integer overflow caused by an unreasonably large input.

claimableRedeemRequest.details: The amount of requested `shares` in Claimable state for the `controller` with the given `requestId` to `redeem` or `withdraw`. - MUST NOT include any `shares` in Pending state for `redeem` or `withdraw`. - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller. - MUST NOT revert unless due to integer overflow caused by an unreasonably large input.

isOperator.details: Returns `true` if the `operator` is approved as an operator for an `controller`.

pendingDepositRequest.details: The amount of requested `assets` in Pending state for the `controller` with the given `requestId` to `deposit` or `mint`. - MUST NOT include any `assets` in Claimable state for deposit or mint. - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller. - MUST NOT revert unless due to integer overflow caused by an unreasonably large input.

pendingRedeemRequest.details: The amount of requested `shares` in Pending state for the `controller` with the given `requestId` to `redeem` or `withdraw`. - MUST NOT include any `shares` in Claimable state for `redeem` or `withdraw`. - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller. - MUST NOT revert unless due to integer overflow caused by an unreasonably large input.

devdoc.title: - Lending Vault

balanceOfUnderlying(address).notice: - Amount of underlying tokens a user's vault shares is redeemable for.

batchProcessDepositRequest(address[],uin.notice: - Processes multiple deposit requests by reducing the pending deposit request and increasing the claimable deposit request.

batchProcessRedeemRequest(address[],uint.notice: - Processes multiple redeem requests by reducing the pending redeem request and increasing the claimable redeem request.

cancelDepositRequest(uint256,address,add.notice: - Cancels a deposit request and sends tokens to receiver.

deposit(uint256,address).notice: - Deposit a specific amount of underlying tokens and receive vault shares.

deposit(uint256,address,address).notice: - Deposit a specific amount of underlying tokens and receive vault shares.

depositIntoStrategy(uint256,uint256).notice: - Deposit assets into the Liquid Strategy or Credit Strategy contract

maxDeposit(address).notice: - The maximum amount of underlying tokens the receiver can deposit into the vault. Per EIP-7540, Increases and decreases in sync with claimableDepositRequest.

maxMint(address).notice: - The maximum amount of vault shares the receiver can mint with underlying tokens.

maxRedeem(address).notice: - The maximum amount of vault shares the owner can redeem. Per EIP-7540, increases and decreases in sync with claimableRedeemRequest.

maxWithdraw(address).notice: - The maximum amount of assets the owner can withdraw from the vault. Increases and decreases in sync with claimableRedeemRequestAssets.

migrateLiquidStrategy(address).notice: - Migrate the Liquid Strategy contract to a new Liquid Strategy contract. Transfers all assets from the old strategy to the new liquid Strategy.

mint(uint256,address).notice: - Receive a specific amount of vault shares in exchange for underlying tokens.

mint(uint256,address,address).notice: - Receive a specific amount of vault shares in exchange for underlying tokens.

mintFeeShares(address,uint256).notice: - Callback to mint shares for the management fee and performance fees.

pause().notice: - Pauses request functions and the ability to deposit or withdraw assets.

processDepositRequest(address,uint256,ui.notice: - Processes a deposit request by reducing the pending deposit request and increasing the claimable deposit request.

processRedeemRequest(address,uint256,uin.notice: - Processes a redeem request by reducing the pending redeem request and increasing the claimable redeem request.

recoverTokens(address,address,uint256).notice: - Transfers ERC20 tokens from the LendingVault contract to arbitrary `to` destination. Can be used to recover tokens not in the underlying asset or in emergency situations.

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: - Redeem a specific amount of shares for underlying tokens from owner.

requestDeposit(uint256,address,address).notice: - Transfers assets from msg.sender into the Vault and submits a Request for asynchronous deposit. Because REQUEST_ID == 0, all requests are aggregated for a single owner.

requestRedeem(uint256,address,address).notice: - Assumes control of shares from owner and submits a Request for asynchronous redeem.  Because REQUEST_ID == 0, all requests are aggregated for a single owner.

setCreditStrategy(address,address[]).notice: - Sets the CreditStrategy contract for the LendingVault.

setOperator(address,bool).notice: - Adds or remove operator approval for msg.sender.

sharePrice().notice: - The value of a single vault share expressed in terms of underlying tokens the vault holds, has deployed to credit lines, and interest owed or repaid on those credit lines.

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: - Returns true if the contract supports the ERC-7540, ERC7575, or ERC165 contract interfaces.

totalAssets().notice: - The total amount of underlying tokens the vault holds or has claim to.

totalLiquidAssets().notice: - The total amount of underlying tokens the vault currently holds.

unpause().notice: - Unpauses request functions and the ability to deposit or withdraw assets.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: - Withdraw a specific amount of underlying tokens from owner's balance.

withdrawFromStrategy(uint256,uint256).notice: - Withdraws assets from the CreditStrategy contract

userdoc.notice: - The LendingVault inherits the ERC4626 and ERC7540 Tokenized Vault standards to enable pooling of capital for lending to Credit Coop Line-Of-Credit-v2 contracts.
